title: San Francisco
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Blue San Francisco Player card, 37°46'30"N 122°25'10"W. Port: the compass has an anchor. Two covered boxes, SEARCH THE LAND and SEARCH THE SEA. Code P1-17b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Put 3 Supply cubes into San Francisco from the reserve, not from the stockpile. Resolved once, when the land box is scratched.
Open door 60 and add it to the board. If 60 is already open, gain 1 action instead.

states.summary: Land only. A long-lost supply cache. Put 3 Supply cubes into this city from the reserve instead of the stockpile. The sea box stays covered.
Sea only. A lost haven has been located but not accessed. Open 60 and add it to the board, or gain 1 action if 60 is already open. The land box stays covered.
Both boxes scratched. Land puts 3 Supply cubes into San Francisco from the reserve. Sea opens door 60, or grants 1 action if 60 is already open.

rules: Blue Player card for San Francisco. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both.
Land: put 3 Supply cubes into this city from the reserve, instead of the stockpile.
Sea: the same lost haven as Los Angeles. Open door 60 and add it to the board, or gain 1 action if 60 is already open.
Neither result is a companion. Each is resolved when its box is scratched.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. The other San Francisco Player card is card 16.
notes: Card id 914. State card ids: state 2 is 1002, state 3 is 1001, state 4 is 1000.
Printed code P1-17b stays on every scratched face.
